_comment_chains: Each slot is a list of techniques; each technique is a chain of attacks. The runtime locks one technique per chain based on press buttons. For now sword carries one technique per slot — multi-technique branching is exercised by unarmed.
_comment_cancel_open: cancel_open_seconds is auto-detected per-attack at clip-load by scanning the watched joints' (default: weapon hand) velocity profile. Auto-detect finds the moment the swing has visibly settled back to combat-stance, so chain advance is seamless. To override (clip-broken edge cases), set `cancel_open_seconds` to a positive clip-local seconds value, and/or list `motion_joints` to scan a different joint set.

two_handed._comment: Pro Sword and Shield Pack ships only one-handed clips. Two-handed slots reuse one-handed variants as placeholders until a Pro Greatsword pack lands.
